experiment_Name: Method A v8 CODE-ACCORD full document, matched cases
experiment_Description: Controlled non-direct-QA comparison, Method A. The source input is the dataset-provided full PDF text; v8 still sends only its 15-line keyword-centered physical-line windows to the model. CODE-ACCORD search terms are derived from the dataset question because the historical German value-key map does not support value='value'; this is an explicit input adaptation. The full-PDF dataset has 292 records; this configuration filters to the 290 filenames in the expanded-passage reference set. The source-match status and mapped PDF remain in request metadata. Uses Gemma 4 31B, temperature 1.0, five repetitions; historical Exp. 11 used Gemma 3 27B.
